plain: The story is that in 1974 an unknown craft crashed near Coyame in Mexico, and that the United States quietly went in and took it. Michels tells it from a report that he says leaked in the 1990s. In that version the object collided with something in mid-air, "the whole Mexican team ends up dead," and the object "is airlifted out by US forces." An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb calls it a favourite of his, while admitting "there's not a ton of supporting evidence." He describes a document called the DEB report as a plan directed by the CIA, the kind an "OGA," or other government agency, would draw up to gather rapid reaction teams and equipment to go and collect the craft. In another episode he mentions Coyame alongside the Majestic documents, papers said to come from a secret UFO group, and says toxic material has sometimes leaked out of crash sites. Neither teller says they took part. Both sum up documents they have read, and if those documents are real, they would show a US crash recovery operation run outside its own borders.
